history.title: About Us
history.subtitle: Domestic Power in the Turkish Defense Industry
history.p1: AQUATIC Elektronik Makina Otomasyon Savunma Sanayi Tic. Ltd. Şti. is a high-tech engineering firm based in Kocaeli Gölcük, with a branch in Istanbul Technopark. With our well-equipped and experienced engineering team suitable for the defense industry infrastructure, we play leading roles in critical projects.
history.p2: We contribute to the production of domestic and national systems, primarily through our expertise in underwater technologies, MIL-STD product development, hardware engineering, and embedded software. We will continue to be your most reliable solution partner for innovative projects of the future.

timeline.2022: Participation in National Black Box project

visionMission.title: Vision & Mission
visionMission.subtitle: Technologies Shaping the Future
visionMission.desc: We aim to become a global player by increasing domestic production capacity in underwater and defense industries.
visionMission.visionText: To become a global brand offering completely domestic and national solutions in underwater and defense technologies. By placing innovation at the center, we aim to reach the position of the leading manufacturer of critical systems contributing to our country's technological independence.
visionMission.missionText: To create value in national and international projects by providing the most suitable, high-quality, and reliable engineering solutions for our clients' needs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common Inquiries
faq.desc: We have compiled the most frequently asked questions regarding our services, working model, and after-sales support.

1.question: Which sectors do you serve?
1.answer: We provide engineering solutions across various sectors, primarily in defense, electronics & automation, machinery, and maritime.

2.question: What is your working model for projects?
2.answer: First, we analyze the requirements, then complete the feasibility and design phases before moving on to prototype, testing, and mass production steps. We keep our clients regularly informed throughout the entire process.

3.question: Do you offer service/maintenance for your products and systems?
3.answer: Yes. We provide post-installation warranty support, periodic maintenance, and on-site service when necessary.

4.question: Do you also work on international projects?
4.answer: Yes, we participate in international projects within the scope of appropriate licenses and regulations.

services.title: Service Groups
services.subtitle: From maritime to defense industry, from underwater technologies to industrial automation — comprehensive engineering services.

denizcilik.title: Aquatic Maritime
denizcilik.desc: A complete set of technical services for the maritime sector, covering ship electrical, machinery, hydraulic-pneumatic and general maintenance-repair activities.

gemiElektrik.title: Ship Electrical Operations
gemiElektrik.desc: Installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical systems on ships.
gemiElektrik.detail: Installation, periodic maintenance, fault detection, and repair of the main and auxiliary electrical systems on board (power distribution panels, generator synchronization systems, lighting, cable wiring, grounding and insulation checks) are carried out. Electrical tests, cable laying, and panel overhaul works compliant with survey and classification society requirements are part of the service. The team applies customized electrical maintenance plans depending on the ship type (commercial, military, special purpose).

gemiMakine.title: Ship Machinery Operations (Main Engine, Generator Maintenance-Repair)
gemiMakine.desc: Periodic maintenance, overhaul and fault repair services for main engine and generator groups.
gemiMakine.detail: Periodic maintenance, overhaul, part replacement, preventive maintenance planning based on oil analysis, and corrective repair services are provided for the ship's main engine and generator sets. Inspection and maintenance of critical subcomponents such as injectors, turbochargers, cooling systems, fuel systems and exhaust lines are also carried out under this scope. The goal is to keep the ship's operational continuity and engine room safety at the highest level.

hidrolikPnomatik.title: Ship Hydraulic-Pneumatic System Repairs
hidrolikPnomatik.desc: Maintenance, repair and overhaul services for ship hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
hidrolikPnomatik.detail: Maintenance, leak testing, hose/gasket replacement, pressure testing, and fault repair are performed for hydraulically/pneumatically driven equipment such as steering gear, cranes, hatch opening-closing systems and deck machinery. Hydraulic pump, valve and cylinder overhauls, as well as periodic checks of pneumatic lines and compressor systems, are also included.

pnomatikMerdiven.title: Pneumatic Accommodation Ladder
pnomatikMerdiven.desc: Pneumatic (air-driven) ladder systems used on ships.
pnomatikMerdiven.detail: Supply, installation and maintenance of pneumatically driven ladder systems used for boarding/disembarking at the ship's side are provided. The system offers fast and safe deployment, improving operational efficiency for crew and personnel transfers. A product catalog is available on request; technical specifications (load capacity, deployment time, material class, etc.) are evaluated on a project basis.

komplebakimOnarim.title: Complete Ship Maintenance-Repair Operations
komplebakimOnarim.desc: A comprehensive, single-point ship maintenance-repair service.
komplebakimOnarim.detail: A complete maintenance-repair package is offered, combining electrical, machinery, hydraulic-pneumatic, pipe outfitting and equipment areas under one roof. From dock entry to exit, planning, work breakdown structure (WBS), parts procurement, labor coordination and final inspection/testing processes are managed end-to-end by Aquatic. This service offers ship owners the convenience of a single point of contact and time savings.

tecizMontajOnarim.title: Outfitting, Installation and Repair Operations
tecizMontajOnarim.desc: Installation, commissioning and repair of ship outfitting equipment.
tecizMontajOnarim.detail: In new-build or modernization projects, the installation, alignment and commissioning of ship outfitting (equipment, machinery, auxiliary systems) is carried out. In addition, troubleshooting of existing equipment, renewal of worn parts, and performance testing are included in the scope of service.

boruDonatim.title: Ship Pipe Outfitting Operations
boruDonatim.desc: Manufacturing, installation and outfitting of ship piping systems.
boruDonatim.detail: Manufacturing of ship piping systems such as fuel, oil, cooling water, bilge, ballast and fire lines is carried out according to design, with installation based on isometric drawings, welding and pressure testing. Corrosion-resistant material selection and classification society-approved workmanship standards are applied.

savunmaSanayi.title: Defense Industry & Underwater Technologies
savunmaSanayi.desc: Special-type cable and connector solutions for critical defense industry applications such as submarine, sonar and torpedo systems. A product family of cables, cameras, and connectors specifically for the underwater environment.

ozelKonnektorler.title: Special-Type Combat System Connectors
ozelKonnektorler.desc: Connector solutions specially designed for military/naval defense systems.
ozelKonnektorler.detail: Special-type connectors are designed and manufactured for defense industry applications requiring high pressure resistance, watertightness, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and shock/vibration resistance. They are engineered in compliance with relevant military standards (MIL-spec, etc.) to meet the uninterrupted and reliable connection needs of systems used in submarines, warships, and underwater platforms.

sonarKablolari.title: Sonar System Cables
sonarKablolari.desc: Custom-manufactured signal and power cables for sonar systems.
sonarKablolari.detail: Low-noise, shielded, and watertight cable solutions are manufactured to suit the high-precision signal transmission requirements of sonar arrays. Signal integrity and long service life are ensured through the use of insulation materials resistant to deep-water pressure and saltwater environments.

torpidoKablolari.title: Torpedo System Cables
torpidoKablolari.desc: Critical cable solutions for torpedo control and launch systems.
torpidoKablolari.detail: Special cable designs requiring high reliability and fault tolerance are developed for the control, telemetry, and power supply lines of torpedo systems. Their structures, resistant to sudden shock, pressure changes, and electromagnetic interference, support the uninterrupted operation of critical mission systems.

sualtiAkustik.title: Underwater Acoustic Systems
sualtiAkustik.desc: Infrastructure solutions for underwater acoustic detection and communication systems.
sualtiAkustik.detail: Cabling, connector, and integration services are provided for underwater acoustic sensor arrays, hydrophone systems, and acoustic communication platforms. The goal is for these systems to demonstrate reliable signal transmission and long-term operational durability under deep-water conditions.

sualtiKablosu.title: Underwater Cable
sualtiKablosu.desc: Special-type cables suitable for underwater use.
sualtiKablosu.detail: Highly watertight, pressure-resistant, corrosion-protected underwater cables are supplied for ROV/AUV systems, underwater sensors, and marine infrastructure projects. A product catalog is available on request; technical details such as depth class, conductor count, cross-section, and jacket material are evaluated on a project basis.

kamera.title: Camera
kamera.detail: High-durability underwater cameras are offered for hull inspections, underwater surveys, ROV integration, and security monitoring purposes. High image quality in low-light conditions and a housing structure resistant to deep-water pressure are among the standout features. Resolution, depth limit, and interface details are shared on a project basis.

konnektor.title: Connector
konnektor.desc: Connector solutions specific to underwater and marine environments.
konnektor.detail: A watertight, pressure-resistant connector product family is offered, enabling underwater equipment to be safely connected to each other and to main systems. See our current product catalog and the /products page for pin count, IP/depth class, and material options.

makina.title: Aquatic Machinery & Industry
makina.desc: Welded fabrication, custom machine manufacturing, machining, and industrial maintenance-repair services. Facility installation, factory infrastructure, and industrial pipe outfitting services.

kaynakliImalat.title: Welded Fabrication and Assembly
kaynakliImalat.desc: Welded fabrication and assembly of steel structures and metal parts.
kaynakliImalat.detail: Welded fabrication of metal components, heat treatment, surface preparation, and final assembly processes are carried out in accordance with project and technical drawings. During quality control stages, weld seams are inspected visually and, where required, through non-destructive testing (NDT) methods.

konveyorler.title: Conveyors
konveyorler.desc: Design and manufacturing of industrial conveying systems.
konveyorler.detail: Design, manufacturing, installation, and commissioning of belt, chain, or roller conveyor systems custom-built for production lines are carried out. Customized solutions are offered based on capacity, material type to be conveyed, and line layout; maintenance and overhaul services for existing conveyor systems are also included.

ozelImalatMakinalar.title: Custom Manufacturing Machines
ozelImalatMakinalar.desc: Production/automation machines custom-designed for the customer.
ozelImalatMakinalar.detail: Special-purpose machines are developed from scratch using a design-manufacturing approach for needs that standard machines cannot meet. Mechanical design, automation integration, prototype production, and on-site commissioning processes are managed end-to-end.

tasarim3d.title: 3D Design and Realization
tasarim3d.detail: CAD-based three-dimensional engineering designs are prepared; processes for physically realizing designs (prototyping, converting to technical drawings for manufacturing, reverse engineering) are supported. Design verification of complex-geometry parts is carried out under this service.

talasliImalat.title: Machining
talasliImalat.detail: Precision-dimensioned part manufacturing is carried out at turning, milling, and CNC machining centers. Production is done from prototype to serial manufacturing, at different scales, with tolerances matching the technical drawing exactly.

trafoEkipmanlari.title: Transformer Industry Production Equipment
trafoEkipmanlari.desc: Equipment and machine solutions for transformer production lines.
trafoEkipmanlari.detail: Design, manufacturing, and maintenance of special-purpose production equipment used in transformer manufacturing facilities are provided. Mechanical solutions that improve process efficiency are developed considering the industry's technical requirements.

bobinSarimMakinalari.title: Coil Winding Machines and Repair Services
bobinSarimMakinalari.desc: Manufacturing and maintenance-repair of coil winding machines.
bobinSarimMakinalari.detail: Design, manufacturing, and installation of coil winding machines used in electric motor and transformer production, as well as periodic maintenance and repair services for existing machines, are offered. Technical support is provided to preserve winding precision and machine performance.

bobinSarimManderelleri.title: Coil Winding Mandrels
bobinSarimManderelleri.desc: Production of mandrels used in coil winding processes.
bobinSarimManderelleri.detail: Precision-toleranced mandrels suitable for different coil sizes and types are manufactured. Custom-sized production can be carried out according to the requested coil geometry.

tesisBoruDonatim.title: Facility Pipe Outfitting and Repair Operations
tesisBoruDonatim.desc: Manufacturing, outfitting, and repair of piping systems in industrial facilities.
tesisBoruDonatim.detail: Manufacturing of process piping systems in factories and facilities (steam, compressed air, water, chemical transfer, etc.) is carried out according to design, along with installation, welding operations, and pressure testing. Repair services are also offered for faults, corrosion, or leaks in existing lines.

tesisFabrikaKurulumu.title: Facility / Factory Installation
tesisFabrikaKurulumu.desc: Turnkey facility and factory installation services.
tesisFabrikaKurulumu.detail: A turnkey installation service is offered, from infrastructure planning of new production facilities to equipment installation, from pipe-electrical outfitting to commissioning processes. Project management, on-site coordination, and final inspection processes are carried out by the Aquatic engineering team.

elektronikOtomasyon.title: Aquatic Electronics and Automation
elektronikOtomasyon.desc: Electronic board design, manufacturing, and automation solutions.

pcbTasarim.title: PCB Design and Manufacturing
pcbTasarim.desc: Printed circuit board (PCB) design and manufacturing services.
pcbTasarim.detail: The entire PCB development process is carried out, from schematic design to layout planning, from prototype production to serial manufacturing. Signal integrity, EMC compliance, and durability are prioritized in board designs requiring high reliability for industrial and defense industry applications.

elektronikTasarim.title: Electronic Design
elektronikTasarim.desc: Electronic engineering design at the circuit and system level.
elektronikTasarim.detail: Electronic circuit and system designs custom-tailored to customer needs are developed; end-to-end engineering support is provided from conceptual design to prototype, from testing to production readiness.

otomasyonEntegrasyon.title: Electronics and Automation
otomasyonEntegrasyon.desc: Integration of industrial automation and control systems.
otomasyonEntegrasyon.detail: Automation infrastructure (PLC, SCADA, sensor integration, control panels) is designed and commissioned for production lines, ship systems, and industrial facilities. Electronic design and automation competencies are combined to offer end-to-end smart system solutions.

descriptions.lhl-401: Compact 1000m-rated subsea LED light with 16W power consumption and 100° coverage angle for underwater applications.

descriptions.ie55-metal-shell-small: Compact metal shell subsea connector with 4 and 6 contact options. Pressure-balanced construction for deep-water equipment.
descriptions.lh-m-fiber-optic: Multi-channel fiber optic underwater connector for subsea ROV tethers. IP68 protection, ceramic contacts, >1000 Mbit/s data rate.

descriptions.rm-series-24: Compact RM series connector for essential power delivery. Available in 2, 3, and 4 contact options.
